question: Why should a critical security validation never rely solely on a Client Script?

choices.text: Because a user can bypass the code running in their browser
Because Client Scripts cannot access fields
Because it consumes too many licenses

explanation: Code running in the browser can be inspected or bypassed by the user; critical validation must be duplicated server-side (Business Rule/ACL).
pieges: Relying on client-side validation alone for a critical business rule.
